gemini-3.8-flash.pricingNotes: Gemini 3.8 Flash introductory pricing is $0.75/1M input and $3.75/1M output tokens through 2026-12-31; standard $1.50/$7.50 rates begin 2027-01-01. AutoShow conservatively uses standard rates for both estimates and usage-based cost calculations, overstating introductory cost. The hourly baseline uses 32 audio tokens/sec; final cost includes prompt, candidate and thinking tokens. Timing is generated, not native word alignment. Reused latency heuristics are provisional. Free tier, caching, batch/flex/priority, taxes and credits are excluded. Automatic date transitions are unsupported; recheck the tariff and refresh all three workflow price paths by 2027-01-01.

limits.notes: Gemini inline audio requests are kept safely under the 20 MB inline request limit; larger inputs use the Files API. Audio input is tokenized at 32 tokens/second, and final billed cost also includes prompt and output tokens.

gemini-3.6-flash.pricingNotes: Gemini 3.6 Flash Standard paid pricing is $1.50/1M input tokens and $7.50/1M output tokens, including thinking tokens. The hourly estimate is the audio-input baseline using 32 audio tokens/sec from the Gemini token docs; completed runs record usageMetadata-based input and output billing when returned. The reused timing estimate is provisional until Phase 3 benchmarking completes. Free tier, batch/flex/priority prices, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

limits.notes: Gemini inline audio requests are kept safely under the 20 MB inline request limit; larger inputs use the Files API. Audio input is tokenized at 32 tokens/second, and final billed cost also includes prompt and output tokens.
